title: Protocatechuic Aldehyde Inhibits alpha-MSH-Induced Melanogenesis in B16F10 Melanoma Cells via PKA/CREB-Associated MITF Downregulation.
one_liner_zh: 该文研究原儿茶醛抑制黑色素生成，涉及酪氨酸酶分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Protocatechuic aldehyde (PA) is a naturally occurring phenolic compound that is a potent inhibitor of mushroom tyrosinase. However, the molecular mechanisms of the anti-melanogenesis activity of PA have not yet been reported. The aim of the current study was to clarify the melanogenesis inhibitory effects of PA and its molecular mechanisms in murine melanoma cells (B16F10). We first predicted the 3D structure of tyrosinase and used a molecular docking algorithm to simulate binding between tyrosinase and PA. These molecular modeling studies calculated a binding energy of -527.42 kcal/mol and indicated that PA interacts with Cu400 and 401, Val283, and His263. Furthermore, PA significantly decreased alpha-MSH-induced intracellular tyrosinase activity and melanin content in a dose-dependent manner. PA also inhibited key melanogenic proteins such as tyrosinase, tyrosinase-related protein 1 (TRP-1), and TRP-2 in alpha-MSH-stimulated B16F10 cells. In addition, PA decreased MITF expression levels by inhibiting phosphorylation of cAMP response element-binding protein (CREB) and cAMP-dependent protein kinase A (PKA). These results demonstrate that PA can effectively suppress melanin synthesis in melanoma cells. Taken together, our results show that PA could serve as a potential inhibitor of melanogenesis, and hence could be explored as a possible skin-lightening agent.
abstract_zh: 原儿茶醛（PA）是一种天然存在的酚类化合物，是蘑菇酪氨酸酶的有效抑制剂。然而，PA抗黑色素生成活性的分子机制尚未见报道。本研究旨在阐明PA在鼠黑色素瘤细胞（B16F10）中对黑色素生成的抑制作用及其分子机制。我们首先预测了酪氨酸酶的三维结构，并使用分子对接算法模拟酪氨酸酶与PA之间的结合。这些分子建模研究计算得出结合能为-527.42 kcal/mol，并表明PA与Cu400和401、Val283及His263相互作用。此外，PA以剂量依赖性方式显著降低了α-MSH诱导的细胞内酪氨酸酶活性和黑色素含量。PA还抑制了α-MSH刺激的B16F10细胞中关键黑色素生成蛋白，如酪氨酸酶、酪氨酸酶相关蛋白1（TRP-1）和TRP-2。另外，PA通过抑制cAMP反应元件结合蛋白（CREB）和cAMP依赖性蛋白激酶A（PKA）的磷酸化，降低了MITF表达水平。这些结果表明，PA能有效抑制黑色素瘤细胞中的黑色素合成。综合来看，我们的结果显示，PA可作为黑色素生成的潜在抑制剂，因此有望被开发为可能的皮肤美白剂。
